## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: A deliberately seeded blocking review thread is resolved by the autonomous loop within the wait window, OR a thread the agent cannot programmatically resolve causes the loop to escalate to the user with the PR URL rather than spinning indefinitely

## Implementation

File: tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh (modify, inside RUN_CI_E2E=1 guard, append Phase 3 after Phase 2)

Context: merge-to-main-pr.sh already implements _phase_resolve_threads with PR_THREAD_LOOP_MAX_DISPATCHES env var control; emits ESCALATE:thread_resolution REASON:dispatch_cap PR:<url> on stderr when cap hit. Unit-level behavior covered by tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh (19 passing tests). This task adds live E2E verification against real GitHub.

Integration exemption criterion 1: unit-level thread escalation behavior is covered by tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh (cited). This E2E test verifies live integration of already-implemented behavior.

1. Create THREAD_BRANCH="e2e-thread-escalation-${TIMESTAMP}" with conforming commit
2. Push branch, create PR via `gh pr create --base main --head "$THREAD_BRANCH"`
3. Extract PR number: `PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view "$THREAD_PR_URL" --json number --jq .number)`
4. Seed review thread (REQUEST_CHANGES): `gh api "repos/${CI_E2E_REPO}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/reviews" --method POST --field body="Intentionally unresolvable thread for DSO E2E test ${TIMESTAMP}" --field event="REQUEST_CHANGES"`
5. Run merge-to-main-pr.sh with escalation-forcing env vars:
   - THREAD_MERGE_STDERR=$(mktemp /tmp/dso-thread-merge-stderr.XXXXXX)
   - PR_THREAD_LOOP_MAX_DISPATCHES=1 PR_THREAD_LOOP_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS=60 bash plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>"$THREAD_MERGE_STDERR"; THREAD_MERGE_EXIT=$?
   - THREAD_STDERR_CONTENT=$(cat "$THREAD_MERGE_STDERR"); rm -f "$THREAD_MERGE_STDERR"
6. Assertions:
   - [ "$THREAD_MERGE_EXIT" -ne 0 ] → _pass "test_thread_escalation_exits_nonzero"
   - echo "$THREAD_STDERR_CONTENT" | grep -q 'ESCALATE:thread_resolution' → _pass "test_thread_escalation_emits_signal"
   - echo "$THREAD_STDERR_CONTENT" | grep -q "$THREAD_BRANCH\|$THREAD_PR_URL" → _pass "test_thread_escalation_emits_pr_url"
7. Register CLEANUP_PR_THREAD and CLEANUP_BRANCH_THREAD in cleanup trap at top of script

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Phase 3 section present in test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'Phase 3' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] test_thread_escalation_emits_pr_url defined
  Verify: grep -q 'test_thread_escalation_emits_pr_url' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] test_thread_escalation_exits_nonzero defined (exit-code assertion is explicit)
  Verify: grep -q 'test_thread_escalation_exits_nonzero' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] PR_THREAD_LOOP_MAX_DISPATCHES=1 used to force escalation
  Verify: grep -q 'PR_THREAD_LOOP_MAX_DISPATCHES=1' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] ESCALATE:thread_resolution asserted in stderr content
  Verify: grep -q 'ESCALATE:thread_resolution' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] Non-zero exit explicitly checked (THREAD_MERGE_EXIT -ne 0)
  Verify: grep -qE 'THREAD_MERGE_EXIT.*-ne 0|-ne 0.*THREAD_MERGE_EXIT' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] Cleanup variables registered for thread branch and PR
  Verify: grep -qE 'CLEANUP_PR_THREAD|CLEANUP_BRANCH_THREAD' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] Phase 3 is inside RUN_CI_E2E=1 guard
  Verify: python3 -c "txt = open('tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh').read(); guard_pos = txt.find('RUN_CI_E2E'); p3_pos = txt.find('Phase 3'); assert guard_pos < p3_pos, 'Phase 3 must be inside RUN_CI_E2E guard'; print('OK')"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add Phase 3 to test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh: thread-resolution escalation negative test
